mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from learning_follow where user_id = #{userId}
select sum(like_count) from learning_post where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

select f.user_id, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = f.user_id) as user_name, (select u.avatar from sys_user u where u.user_id = f.user_id) as avatar from learning_follow f where f.follow_user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc, f.follow_id desc limit #{limit}
